description: This file defines the AclEntry interface, representing a single entry of an Access Control List within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating new ACL entries, retrieving associated authorization subjects and permissions, and serializing to JSON. The interface is part of the deprecated API version 1.

classes.name: AclEntry
classes.description: An interface representing a single entry in an Access Control List, including methods to retrieve authorization subject, permissions, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new immutable ACL entry with a specified authorization subject and permissions.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions for this ACL entry; here it only supports version 1.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization subject associated with this ACL entry.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the ACL entry contains the specified permission.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks if the ACL entry contains all specified permissions.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves the permissions associated with this ACL entry.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ACL entry to a JSON object, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overload)
methods.description: Serializes the ACL entry to a JSON object with options for schema version and field selection.
